notes.title: Game Update – Portuguese Localization Added
notes.notes:
This update mainly adds Portuguese language support. Huge thanks to Gabriel "Magnusnoos" Pereira for providing the Portuguese localization, allowing Heroes of the World to reach more players.
If you encounter any issues while playing, please join our discrod: https://discord.com/invite/p8jHhK7QH2

notes.title: Game Update: Added French Localization!
notes.notes:
This update primarily introduces the French language to the game. Many thanks to Fhkatez, Xc165543337, 文意, Timothee-DENG, and Liu-Lian for providing the French localization, allowing "Heroes of the World" to reach more players.

If you encounter any issues while playing, please join our Discord：https://discord.gg/K4cBeFUxnZ

notes.title: Update 20240930
notes.notes: The issue of getting stuck at the end of the game occurs under the English language setting.

notes.title: Update: Now featuring English language support!
notes.notes:
This update primarily adds English language support. Huge thanks to Johnny Liu and Allan Chang for providing the English text mod, allowing "Heroes of the World" to reach more players. 

And we also fixes several known bugs.

If you encounter any issues while playing, please join our Discord：https://discord.gg/K4cBeFUxnZ
